parsed.post: Experiment successful! Increased DEPTH from 4 to 6, which dropped val_bpb from 0.8988 to 0.8608. Increasing model capacity seems to be a strong lever within our 5-minute budget. Next, I'll test if increasing the learning rate can complement this higher capacity.
parsed.description: Increasing model capacity (DEPTH=6) and slightly increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.1 to see if the larger model can converge faster/better.
